data: synthetic: a queue-reactive simulator with made-up parameters, no market data
bounds: One synthetic simulator, made-up parameters and 24 days per regime bound what this comparison can show.
origin: The days, digests, splits, execution and fee rule of #103 (experiments/m4_06): queue-reactive days sampled every second. #110 reads #103's digests and its fee rule output; it generates no data.
holdout_rule: Holdout rows are generated only to fix their digests here, and are written apart. No run reads them until every checkpoint and configuration is frozen and its hash recorded.

execution.fee: the fee #103's fee_rule step chose, read from its output and pinned by hash; and the secondary row at 0.0002
execution.latency_note: submit and cancel delays of 25 (as #103), 100 and 500 ms; every delay is well under a row of 1 s, so the one-row boundary of #268 cannot occur

duration.meaning: the policy chooses, with each decision, how many rows its quote rests before it decides again: the decision time, a wrapper over the environment (as DecisionInterval, with the interval chosen per action). Self-expiring orders need a cancel-only action the environment lacks (#288).
duration.between_decisions: the resting orders stay and nothing is sent; cancels take effect after the cancel latency, so fills in flight stand
fixtures: a fill landing inside the cancel latency of a replacing quote is kept
a duration ending while a cancel is in flight cancels at the cancel's effective time, not earlier
a cancel arriving after the order filled is counted as cancel rejected

predictor.what: an auxiliary observation feature: a linear forecast of the mid change over the next 5 rows from the current observation, fitted by least squares on training days only and then fixed
predictor.fit: training days, every row, every regime pooled

teacher.what: a warm start from a classical policy: behaviour cloning of the Avellaneda-Stoikov point chosen on #103's training-day fee rule, for 100000 decisions on training days, then PPO from those weights
teacher.report: as a warm start from a classical policy, with the no-teacher ablation beside it

action_space.duration_component: one more Box value in [-1, 1], binned onto the duration choices

avellaneda_stoikov.selection: as #103, on validation, at every latency

hyperparameters.note: one set for every learned arm: the set #102 selected for PPO; a limit of this comparison

training_days: each learned run trains on the pooled training days of every regime; every reset draws one of those days from the run's seed

evaluation.daily_value: a day's exact net result; a learned arm's day is the mean over its training seeds

metrics: fills, cancels and cancels rejected per hour
markout of fills at 1, 5 and 30 s
inventory: mean and largest absolute position, time beyond 5 lots

decision_rule.duration: full against no_duration at each latency: 90 % block bootstrap over days on the paired daily net difference; duration helps when the lower bound is above 0 and no arm breached a limit
decision_rule.ablations: full against no_teacher and against no_predictor, the same way
decision_rule.no_trade: every learned arm against no_trade; one whose interval includes 0 is reported as equivalent to not trading
decision_rule.not_compared: no batch auction result exists here (#289), and none is compared with these

reproduction: the reduced batch setting of the paper is not reproduced in this round (#289); the PR uses Refs #110

compute.overrun_rule: a step that overruns its estimate by more than 50 % stops and is reported, without cutting seeds

steps.name: training
steps.what: 4 learned arms x 3 latencies x 5 seeds
